_comment: Data-preprocessing config for the Fruit-Cheating-LLM LoRA SFT dataset. Permissive-license + platform-safe (SFW) only. Two-tier: 'fruit' rows use the fruit system prompt; all other ('voice') rows teach general dramatic writing + twists. Caps are targets; max_scan bounds how many source rows are streamed to find qualifying rows.

screenplay_voice._note: re-enabled with <think> stripped; global dedup caps it to unique rows (source is duplicative, so it contributes only its distinct outputs).

gutenberg_melodrama._note: re-enabled: pulls dialogue-rich dramatic chunks from ~one 200MB shard's worth of public-domain books (max_scan = books).
